chunks: For them is punishment in this world; and the punishment of the world to come is far more severe. They will have no one to save them from God.
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of punishment for disbelievers in this world and the next according to Surah Ar-Ra'd?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Ra'd highlights the dual nature of divine retribution, where worldly afflictions serve as a precursor to the more intense, eternal punishment of the Hereafter. It underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah, noting that disbelievers lack any intercessor or protector (waqī) other than Him, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (ʿAdl) where the severity of the penalty matches the depth of their disbelief.
